newsitem.title: USA: H.E.R.C. Products names new CFO.
newsitem.headline: H.E.R.C. Products names new CFO.

text.p: H.E.R.C. Products Inc said it named John Johnson as its new chief financial officer.
Johnson succeeds Gary Glatter, who continues as H.E.R.C.'s president and chief operating officer.

Johnson retired in 1990 as chief financial officer-vice president of finance at the New York Stock Exchange. Since then he has been acting chief financial officer for Boyt Co, a manufacturer of luggage and hunting supplies, and interim treasurer for Rodale Press Inc, a book and magazine publisher.
